item.title: Equipmake to supply Agrale with electric bus drivetrains
item.description: UK-based electrification technology firm Equipmake has signed a £2.4-million ($3.28-million) agreement to supply Argentine-Brazilian bus manufacturer Agrale with electric drivetrain systems for 23 electric buses. The new deal follows a September 2025 agreement worth £5.45 million, under which Equipmake supplied drivetrain systems for 50 Agrale electric buses that are now being deployed in Buenos Aires,... item.title: Raythink outlines a three-layer approach to monitoring lithium-ion thermal risks
item.description: Thermal imaging firm Raythink has released a white paper outlining a three-layer approach to monitoring thermal risks across the lithium-ion battery lifecycle, from production and testing through charging, energy storage and end-of-life recycling. item.description: U.S. Energy has added a smaller model to its Volt Vault mobile EV charging line. item.title: Infineon launches isolated gate driver ICs with opto-emulator input for SiC migration
item.description: As the power electronics industry shifts from silicon IGBTs to SiC MOSFETs—driven largely by the efficiency demands of EV inverters, onboard chargers and DC fast charging—one persistent headache has been the gate driver. item.title: Ionic Mineral Technologies expands land lease at Utah rare earth project
item.description: US-based Ionic Mineral Technologies has expanded the lease rights for its Silicon Ridge rare earth project in Utah and completed a strategic step-out drilling program for its Preliminary Economic Assessment (PEA).
